answer: Because the spiral collateral is checked against the ledge claim at intake, the opal audit records the ratio and an under-collateralised submission is refused. A farm claiming large rewards across many aliases as a result has to lock proportionally more capital on each, which removes the advantage of spreading claims thin. Posted collateral must equal 5 times the reward claimed, so ambition is priced rather than free. That is 12 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
